# HAPI v0.30.7.7

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebased on newer official main (4233bf875). Already carried here and now official: #2097, #2098, #2101, #2102 and OpenCode v2 (#2042). New official changes: Codex compaction waits told apart from unknown delivery (#2115), cached hub settings reads (#2122), composer image preview and attachment removal fixes (#2124, #2128), Android permission-mode chip and verdict details (#2123, #2125).
- New carries:
  - Web: the sidebar no longer stalls every few seconds with many sessions. Rows in collapsed groups are unmounted and unchanged rows skip re-renders (#2165).
  - Claude: the model picker offers Default, Opus, Fable, Sonnet and Haiku (#2153). This replaces #1948, which is no longer carried; the old `[1m]` presets are gone.
  - Claude: switching a remote session from Yolo or Accept Edits back to Default takes effect (#2158), and local TUI sessions start in the session's permission mode (#2159).
- No longer carried: #1836 (manual Luna Reserve model choice) and #2024, both closed upstream by their author; #2069 already covers #2024. #1542's history-preservation change stays, now carried as part of #1597, which contains it.
- Refreshed: #2092 (merge-only head update) and OpenCode mid-turn Steer #1981 (steer receipts reconciled after dispatch).
- Hub database schema is unchanged from v0.30.7.6.

## Compared with the official release

- Rebuilt from official main 4233bf8759de02b7d0a8ca79bd731d549738c114 (official release train v0.30.7), with audited open PR carries listed in the release record.
- Includes Claude mid-turn Steer, the maintained session-control workflow, voice draft delivery, notification, composer, session-list, file-search, Codex runner and DSH fixes.
- Retains signed macOS CLI artifacts, standalone Linux/Windows CLIs, desktop packages, four-part release gates and a replayable release manifest.
- Fork-only features removed in v0.30.7.3 remain omitted. Closed unmerged PR #847 remains absent; PR #1320 is never replayed as a carry.

Complete per-PR decisions and personal policy exceptions: tools/maintenance/releases/v0.30.7.7/.
